## What's new in 1.11.1

- **Updates moved to the ⋮ More menu**, first in the list, above Export list (it was in Settings). It shows the update status as before; the update server is pasted there too.
- **Updates on the gateway**: its web page (Linux, Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, Windows) has an **Updates** tab with the version, the update server, the last check and what's offered, **Check now** and **Install** (also when the server says *Ask*; checked against the release signature, then the gateway restarts on the new version). On OpenWrt, LuCI has **Check for updates** and **Install update**. Over SSH: `gundil-gateway update [--install]`.
